sample_unit: synthetic questions per condition (plus a 12-case public check)

links.outcome: Supported-error citation veneer (evidential support present but clinically incorrect) by response regime
links.effect: Synthetic: RUSH 93.3% evidential support, 73.3% correctness, 25.8% veneer. Public check (n=12): RUSH 66.7% veneer (95% CI 39.1%-86.2%); VERIFY and POSTER none.
links.quote: In the 12-case public check, RUSH produced 66.7% CEAG-V veneer (95% CI 39.1%-86.2%), whereas VERIFY and POSTER produced none; because n=12, these public-case rates are descriptive pilot data only.

unlisted_practices: Analyst-facing fixed-length audit tag (CENHOV/CEAG) encoding correctness, evidential support, numeric concordance, hedging, ornamentation and a derived veneer marker for monitoring LLM outputs

screen.reason: Evaluates a proposed audit monitoring grid (CEAG) for clinical analysts to detect citation veneer (hallucinations that appear well-cited) in LLM-generated health outputs.

primary.practice: citation audit grid / hallucination monitoring surface
